title: Pair of scissors with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- handles (left, orange) -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="72" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#ff8a1e"/>
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="72" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#5a2a00"/>
  <!-- handle shine -->
  <ellipse cx="23" cy="69" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffd9a8"/>
  <!-- handles (right, teal) -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="72" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#19d3c5"/>
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="72" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#04443f"/>
  <!-- handle shine -->
  <ellipse cx="71" cy="69" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#b6fff7"/>

  <!-- left blade (steel blue) -->
  <polygon points="34,62 62,14 50,14 30,58" fill="#9fd8ff"/>
  <polygon points="34,62 62,14 56,14 31,58" fill="#e6f7ff"/>

  <!-- right blade (light silver) -->
  <polygon points="66,62 38,14 50,14 70,58" fill="#d4e9ff"/>
  <polygon points="66,62 38,14 44,14 69,58" fill="#7fb8e6"/>

  <!-- pivot screw, bright yellow -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="5" fill="#ffe14d"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#ffaa00"/>

  <!-- smiling face on the left blade -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="2.2" fill="#3a1c00"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="38" r="2.2" fill="#3a1c00"/>
  <path d="M39 46 Q46 52 54 45" stroke="#3a1c00" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- little rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#ff6b6b" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="43" r="2.5" fill="#ff6b6b" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
